agency_play.build_scope: Partial-functionality service: predictive-analytics engagements replicating NEXUS use cases with commodity AutoML/classic ML - demand forecasting, churn scoring, price optimization, fraud rules - delivered as models + dashboards on client data.
agency_play.packaging: Productized 'Forecast-in-6-weeks' fixed-scope package; monthly model-ops retainer for retraining/drift; vertical variants per industry.
agency_play.first_clients: Mid-market e-commerce, logistics and fintech ops teams with clean warehouses but no DS team - exactly the buyers impressed by NEXUS marketing but priced out of it.
